label: Shure UA844+/LC (470-960 MHz, Less power cable)

_avail.note: Less power cable (LC) version; data from UA844+ user guide. Datasheet URL = PDF of official user guide (no separate spec sheet linked). Price list net weight 3.992 kg differs from datasheet weight (datasheet value used).

portsSource.note: Model variations and front/rear panels p.4; cascading p.6; specifications pp.7-8

_avail.notes: Weight changed 1.6 kg -> 1.62 kg per UA844+ guide p.7. /LC: same unit, ships without the locking DC cords and with 2 instead of 10 short BNC cables (guide p.6).; Variant "Less power cable" → "470-960 MHz, Less power cable" (from the part number; the intake form gave one Variant to several part numbers)
_avail.portsMissing: The guide does not state the number of RF outputs per channel in text (5 per channel assumed from 'up to five receivers' and the 10 supplied BNC cables); the front-panel Antenna A/B connectors (front-mount antenna hardware) are not modelled separately. Number of RF output jacks per antenna channel is not stated in the UA844+ user guide (panel drawing not in the PDF): RF Out A / RF Out B are modelled once each; verify against the rear panel.

ports.label: RF In A
ports.notes: BNC, 50 ohm; antenna input with 15 V DC bias (150 mA max); 470-960 MHz (SWB)

ports.label: RF In B
ports.notes: BNC, 50 ohm; antenna input with 15 V DC bias (150 mA max); 470-960 MHz (SWB)

ports.label: RF Out A
ports.notes: BNC, 50 ohm, to receiver antenna inputs A; the guide (p.4) names "RF Output A" but does not state how many jacks (one system supports up to five receivers, cascade included)

ports.label: RF Out B
ports.notes: BNC, 50 ohm, to receiver antenna inputs B; the guide (p.4) names "RF Output B" but does not state how many jacks (one system supports up to five receivers, cascade included)

ports.label: Cascade Out A
ports.notes: BNC, 50 ohm; to antenna input A of a secondary UA844+

ports.label: Cascade Out B
ports.notes: BNC, 50 ohm; to antenna input B of a secondary UA844+

ports.label: DC In
ports.notes: 15 V DC (2.54 A) from the external power supply; 14-18 V DC range; Shure does not name the connector

ports.label: DC Out 1
